name: Business Strategy {OS}
tagline: The strategy of the business as an asset, not as a job.

commands.name: /thesis
commands.summary: Write or revise the asset thesis: what a buyer would be buying, and why it is not just the owner.

commands.name: /dependence
commands.summary: Score owner dependence per decision class, naming the specific decisions that live only in the owner's head.

commands.name: /drivers
commands.summary: Build and maintain the value driver table, each entry labelled verified or unverified with its source and date.

commands.name: /advantage
commands.summary: Run the copy test on each claimed advantage and maintain the durable advantage register.

commands.name: /readiness
commands.summary: Compute the gap to a stated readiness standard, always naming the unverified inputs and showing the gap without them.

commands.name: /options
commands.summary: Generate the strategic option set, each option naming the driver it moves, its cost and its reversibility.

commands.name: /value-range
commands.summary: Produce an internal working valuation range from the operator's own numbers, with method and inputs exposed. Not an audited valuation.

commands.name: /review
commands.summary: Run the review cadence, report the delta, and attach the age of every carried forward measurement.

requires_human_approval_for: publishing or revising the asset thesis
recording a readiness gap that will be handed to exit-liquidity-os
sending any finding or proposal to another OS
carrying a stale measurement forward into a current readiness claim
sharing any output outside the operator's own systems
any action that would move money, sign a document, change a contract, restructure an entity or execute a transaction, none of which this OS performs
